name: queue
description: A bounded queue between threads for a loop on each core: net Handoffs, accepted sockets in no Poll, with a tag, from the thread that accepts to a worker's loop, whose Poll each push wakes; a line under the system's mutex with condition variables for threads that may block, no lock-free code; a push to a full queue refused at once with the connection given back; Closed once every Sender is gone. Its tests run a server on N threads, a Poll each, over SO_REUSEPORT listeners on Linux and an accept thread that hands off on macOS and Windows, and bench its connections a second.
